summary: Set champion roles, induction tracking, hazard escalation, and reporting workflows. Review the five-day safety champion program course.
lede: Safety champion programs give safety coordinators and frontline supervisors a structured way to involve workers in routine safety activities and follow up on hazards. Training covers mapping role boundaries, creating induction and competency records, designing observation and escalation routes, checking controls, and tracking corrective actions with a simple scorecard.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits you if you coordinate frontline safety participation, supervise work where hazards are reported, or need to show how champion activity connects to follow-up. It is designed for roles that can influence workplace procedures and work with safety teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace hazard reporting and basic health and safety procedures is expected. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available for tracker and scorecard exercises.
